title: close saves separate cancel
rule: Treat Close as dismiss-and-keep-work and provide a separate Cancel to abandon; when in doubt, save then out.
pass_when: Close (or X-as-close) dismisses and keeps work; a separate Cancel abandons; when in doubt, save then out.
fail_when: One control means both keep and abandon, or Close discards with no separate abandon path.
overview: Close (or X-as-close) dismisses and keeps work.
not_when: Not for unclear Continue / Submit label.
agent_hint: Treat Close as dismiss-and-keep-work and provide a separate Cancel to abandon.
description: Treat Close as dismiss-and-keep-work and provide a separate Cancel to abandon. Close (or X-as-close) dismisses and keeps work. It fails when One control means both keep and abandon, or Close discards with no separate abandon path.
